data.title: Income Tax Assessment 2025 (Einkommensteuerbescheid)
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterflens assessed the 2025 income tax return, using the flat annual allowance for home office costs instead of the amount claimed, resulting in a tax refund of €723.00.
data.explanation: The tax office (Finanzamt) reviewed your 2025 income tax return and changed how it calculated your home office (Arbeitszimmer) costs, using a flat yearly allowance instead of your claimed figure. This resulted in a refund of €723.00, which will be paid to the account you gave in your tax return — no action is needed for that. If you disagree with how the home office costs were calculated, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt; the app shows the deadline for this. If you miss it, the assessment becomes final as issued.
data.tax_note: This is the official income tax assessment for 2025; keep it as a record of your assessed income, deductions, and the home office allowance applied, and of the resulting refund.

items.title: Deadline to object (Einspruch) to the tax assessment
items.action: Decide whether you want to object (Einspruch) to how the home office costs were calculated, and file it in writing, via ELSTER, or for the record with the Finanzamt before the deadline shown.
